iterations.title: Predator / Prey — Advanced
iterations.description: Richer predator-prey dynamics: predators grow when eating, prey have a death-and-respawn lifecycle, soft vortex pressure keeps the field alive. Six tunable parameters.

iterations.title: Predator / Prey
iterations.description: Two agent classes — prey flee from nearby predators, predators chase nearby prey. Opposite local rules, emergent pursuit-and-evasion dynamics, one simulation loop.

artifacts.title: Interactive
artifacts.description: Move your cursor left ↔ right to see how the perception radius scales with x position.

artifacts.title: Sign Flip
artifacts.description: Toggle between p − other and other − p to see how one sign flip inverts flee into chase.

iterations.title: Avoidance
iterations.description: Agents steer away from neighbors within a local radius, producing emergent spacing and flow without any global coordination.

artifacts.title: Interactive
artifacts.description: Drag neighbors into the radius and watch the vectors update in real time.

artifacts.title: Loop Step
artifacts.description: Step through loop iteration i to see how all GPU threads evaluate the same agent simultaneously.

iterations.title: Stochastic Drift
iterations.description: A per-agent random perturbation applied to velocity each frame. Agents individuate through noise, not interaction.
